definitions.explanation: Having the ability or skills needed to do something well.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{有能|ゆうのう}な{弁護士|べんごし}だ。
{有能|ゆうのう}な{人材|じんざい}を{求|もと}めています。
examples.english: We are looking for talented personnel.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{有能|ゆうのう}で{信頼|しんらい}できる。

notes:
USAGE: {有能|ゆうのう} is used to describe someone with demonstrated ability or competence, especially in professional contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{有能|ゆうのう}な{人|ひと} (capable person)
・{有能|ゆうのう}な{人材|じんざい} (talented personnel)
・{有能|ゆうのう}な{スタッフ} (capable staff)

CONTRAST:
・{無能|むのう} - incompetent, incapable

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{優秀|ゆうしゅう} - excellent (emphasizes high quality)
・{有能|ゆうのう} - capable (emphasizes practical ability)
